capture.name: Capture overlay metadata
capture.description: Read fresh original modes, temperatures, termination types and absolute expiry times. Returns snapshots and per-zone errors; does not change heating.

config_entry_id.name: Metadata integration
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one Tado Overlay Metadata entry is loaded.

zone_ids.name: Zone IDs
zone_ids.description: Optional list of positive integer Tado zone IDs. Omit to read all zones.

restore_timed_off.name: Restore timed OFF
restore_timed_off.description: Write an OFF timer until the supplied original UTC expiry. Does not check windows or heating season; the caller must do that. Expired input is rejected. Returns the requested deadline; verify through capture if needed.

config_entry_id.name: Metadata integration
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one Tado Overlay Metadata entry is loaded.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Positive integer Tado heating zone ID.

expires_at.name: Original expiry
expires_at.description: Original absolute UTC Unix timestamp in seconds. Must still be in the future.
